## Description

Brief description of the change and the motivation. Link related issues with `Fixes #<n>` / `Closes #<n>` where applicable.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows the project's design principles (SOLID, minimal redundancy, centralized configuration)
- [ ] Unit / component tests were added or updated (coverage target > 90%)
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run test:run` pass locally
- [ ] UI-related changes were verified in a browser
- [ ] Relevant docs were updated (`docs/`, `tests/UI_TEST_GUIDE.md`) where applicable
